title: Sauce Demo Shopify Homepage Header
content: The homepage header of https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/ contains the site logo, a navigation menu with links to Home, Catalog, and Contact, a search icon, and a cart icon. The header is fixed at the top and remains visible as the user scrolls. All navigation links are clickable and direct the user to the appropriate pages. The cart icon displays the number of items in the cart.
